title.zh: FT: DWF Labs Sues BitGo for $141 Million Over Alleged Early Sales of Locked Toke
title.en: FT: DWF Labs Sues BitGo for $141 Million Over Alleged Early Sales of Locked Toke

current_state.zh: DWF Labs affiliates sued crypto custodian BitGo in London's High Court for $141 million, alleging BitGo sold Falcon Finance and ESPORTS tokens ahead of agreed lock-up and vesting periods, depressing prices and DWF's remaining holdings.
current_state.en: DWF Labs affiliates sued crypto custodian BitGo in London's High Court for $141 million, alleging BitGo sold Falcon Finance and ESPORTS tokens ahead of agreed lock-up and vesting periods, depressing prices and DWF's remaining holdings.
